glosses: when it comes to (of all things)
patterns.usage_note: Marks the point a progression finally reaches, and in its dominant に至っては shape it singles out the most extreme member of a series already named (遅刻が続き、昨日に至っては無断欠勤だ), with the following clause delivering dismay or a damning verdict. The near-synonyms ともなると and にもなると only note that a threshold brings its natural consequences. Written and formal-spoken register.

examples.ruby: 兄[あに]は三杯[さんばい]、弟[おとうと]に至[いた]っては十杯[じゅっぱい]も平[たい]らげた。
examples.english: My older brother had three bowls, and my younger brother put away ten.

examples.ruby: 遅刻[ちこく]が続[つづ]き、昨日[きのう]に至[いた]っては無断[むだん]欠勤[けっきん]だ。
examples.english: He kept turning up late, and yesterday he simply failed to show at all.

examples.ruby: 話[はなし]が費用[ひよう]に至[いた]ると、全員[ぜんいん]が黙[だま]り込[こ]んだ。
examples.english: The moment the discussion got as far as cost, the whole room went silent.

patterns.usage_note: Raises a noun to a notable status, age, or occasion and presents what follows as the consequence anyone would expect of it (プロともなると、練習の量からして違う), with も adding wonder at the level reached. The sibling にもなると pairs more readily with ages, grades, and dates, where ともなると takes statuses and roles. Plain となると attaches freely to clauses (一人で暮らすとなると); ともなると favors nouns.

examples.ruby: プロともなると、練習[れんしゅう]の量[りょう]からして違[ちが]う。
examples.english: Once you're a professional, even the sheer volume of practice is different.

examples.ruby: 店長[てんちょう]ともなれば、売[う]り上[あ]げの責任[せきにん]も背負[せお]う。
examples.english: Once you're the store manager, the sales figures land on your shoulders too.

examples.ruby: 一人[ひとり]で暮[く]らすとなると、家賃[やちん]がまず問題[もんだい]だ。
examples.english: Once living alone is actually on the table, rent is the first hurdle.

patterns.usage_note: Presents a stage reached (an age, a school year, a point in the calendar) and states what naturally holds there (高校にもなると、親に相談しなくなる). Compared with ともなると it is less exclamatory and pairs readily with numbers and periods, where ともなると takes statuses and roles. Dropping も gives plain になると, the same shift without marking the stage as a notable one.

examples.ruby: 高校[こうこう]にもなると、親[おや]に相談[そうだん]しなくなるものだ。
examples.english: Once they're in high school, kids stop bringing things to their parents.

examples.ruby: 十二月[じゅうにがつ]にもなると、朝[あさ]の空気[くうき]が刺[さ]すように痛[いた]い。
examples.english: Once December rolls around, the morning air stings your skin.

examples.ruby: 五十[ごじゅう]になると、小[ちい]さな文字[もじ]がぼやけて見[み]える。
examples.english: When you hit fifty, small print starts going blurry on you.
